playbookOutputs: SARS Customs client number (importer code) issued via RLA
RLA approval notification / customs registration letter
Note on importer obligations (clearing agent use, tariff classification, ITAC permits for controlled goods)
playbookCommonFailures: No active registered representative on the entity's SARS profile — RLA will not accept the application
Cell number on the SARS profile cannot be verified: the affidavit / invoice / accountant's letter does not tie the number to the entity or the representative
Bank confirmation letter is in a director's personal name rather than the applicant entity's
Tax compliance status not in good standing (outstanding returns or debt) at the time of RLA submission
Proof of business address older than 3 months or a P.O. Box / virtual office that Customs will not accept as physical premises

informationToProvide.label: Company Registration Documents (CIPC CoR 14.3)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the company CoR 14.3 registration certificate.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official CIPC CoR14.3 (or CK1/CK2) showing the registered name, enterprise number and active directors.

informationToProvide.label: Certified SA ID Copies of All Directors / Public Officer (Not Older Than 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload certified SA ID copies (< 3 months) of all directors and the Public Officer.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Mandatory CIPC/SARS KYC Invariant: South African citizens MUST submit a certified SA ID (Smart ID Card front AND back, or Green Barcoded ID Book) certified within the last 3 months by a Commissioner of Oaths or SAPS. Foreign nationals may submit a certified/apostilled foreign passport accompanied by a valid visa/permit. Verify legible ID/passport number, full legal names, and certification stamp date within 90 days.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of Physical Business Address (Not Older Than 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload proof of the physical business address (< 3 months) in the entity name.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Proof of the PHYSICAL business address dated within 3 months, in the entity name. Customs will not accept a P.O. Box or virtual office.

informationToProvide.label: Bank Confirmation Letter in the Name of the Business or Individual (Not Older Than 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload an official stamped or QR-verified bank confirmation letter in the applicant name (< 3 months).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official Bank Account Confirmation Letter from a registered South African bank in the APPLICANT name dated within 3 months.

informationToProvide.label: Invoice, Sworn Affidavit, or Accountant Letter Confirming the Cellphone Number Linked to the Entity SARS Profile
informationToProvide.helpText: SARS RLA requires proof of the cellphone number on SARS Registered Details (cellphone invoice or commissioned affidavit).
informationToProvide.aiHint: SARS RLA requires a verifiable cell number on the profile. Accept a cellphone contract/invoice, commissioned affidavit, or accountant letter.

informationToProvide.label: Detailed Description of Goods to be Imported, Countries of Origin, HS Tariff Codes (if known) & Expected Annual Import Value
informationToProvide.helpText: Describe the goods to be imported, countries of origin, expected annual import value, and whether a clearing agent will be used.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Plain description of the goods, their origin countries and HS/tariff codes if known.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling Username
informationToProvide.helpText: Primary eFiling username for your personal or company profile. Please ensure the username is active.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling Password
informationToProvide.helpText: ⚠️ IMPORTANT: Please test your password on sarsefiling.co.za before submitting to avoid delays or account lockouts. (Stored encrypted at rest).

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling OTP Required? (Yes / No)
informationToProvide.helpText: Specify Yes or No (does your eFiling login trigger an SMS OTP or SARS Mobile App push notification?).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Confirmation of whether SARS eFiling login requires multi-factor authentication (OTP/App push).

informationToProvide.label: Best Time to Contact for SARS OTP
informationToProvide.helpText: Select preferred date, time slot, and direct phone number so our team can coordinate live OTP approval.
informationToProvide.conditionalQuestion: If OTP is required, when is the best time and number to contact you?
informationToProvide.aiHint: Client preferred date, time window, and contact number for live OTP coordination.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect RLA supporting documents and credentials
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All required uploads received, goods description and cell number captured
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Name each document and why Customs needs it. Stress three things: the bank letter and address proof must be in the applicant's name and within 3 months; the entity must already have an active registered representative on SARS; and the cell number must be provable. Ask whether they will use a clearing agent. Do not promise faster than 1-2 working days for our submission — SARS approval can take longer.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Check registered representative, cell number and compliance status on eFiling
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Active registered representative confirmed; cell number on SARS Registered Details matches the proof supplied; TCS Compliant
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Under SARS Registered Details confirm: (1) registered representative active — if not, stop and propose the Tax Representative Appointment service; (2) the cell number on the profile equals the number in the affidavit/invoice/letter — if it differs, the RAV01 contact details must be updated first (OTP will be sent; hand off to Kevin); (3) Tax Compliance Status Compliant — if not, draft a client message listing what is outstanding. Never attempt OTP or CAPTCHA.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify documents against Customs RLA requirements
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All uploads pass the rules engine or are approved by Kevin
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Entity is the importer, not the ordering contact. Bank letter and address must be in the entity's name; CoR14.3 must match. Check the goods list for ITAC-controlled items and note it for the deliver step. If the client has no cell-number proof, draft the accountants_letter for Kevin's signature.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Prepare RLA importer application hand-off sheet
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Hand-off sheet with every RLA field value and the document upload list posted for Kevin
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Fields (RLA 'Importer' client type — the DA185 equivalent): applicant details, income tax and VAT numbers, physical and postal address, contact person and cell, bank details, nature of goods / tariff description, countries of origin, whether a clearing agent will be used and its customs code, expected annual import value. Fill from verified facts only; leave unknowns blank and flag.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Submit importer registration on eFiling RLA
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: RLA application staged with all documents attached; Kevin submits and the RLA case/reference number is recorded
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Path: eFiling > Customs > Registration Licensing and Accreditation (RLA) > New Application > Client type 'Importer' (⚠ verify current menu names). Stage all values from the hand-off sheet, attach: CoR14.3, certified ID of representative, bank letter, proof of address, cell-number proof. Screenshot each screen and stop for Kevin to submit. Record the reference number.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for Customs approval
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Customs client number issued on RLA dashboard / approval notification received
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Check the RLA dashboard status at each follow-up. Customs may request additional documents or a site inspection; if so create a proposal for Kevin and a plain client message. Escalate via the Customs contact centre with the reference number if no movement by day 10.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver customs client number and obligations note
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Customs code, approval notice and guidance posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Explain: give the customs client number to the clearing agent, keep customs records for 5 years, and controlled goods need an ITAC permit. Mention that the profile must be kept current on RLA (address/bank changes). Offer the export licence if they trade both ways.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
